description: ID-One Cosmo V8.1 is a dual interface (ISO 7816 & ISO 14443) smartcard chip compliant with Javacard 3.0.4 and GlobalPlatform 2.2.1 chip which support ECC CDH both for in module key establishment and for primitive only as required by PIV.
version: HW = ‘30’ with FW = ‘5F01’ and HW = ‘40’ with FW = ‘6001’ 07837.15 (Firmware)
